decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-11fb66b0329a] states that existing Compositions keep working with Crossplane v2. It says v2 managed resources (MRs) have the same schema as v1 but are namespaced, and that the legacy cluster-scoped MRs remain available (for example s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta2 is "Legacy, cluster scoped"). The subject is Composition templates that reference MRs. The change is an optional, additive one: a composition switches to namespaced MRs by changing the API group from .crossplane.io to .m.crossplane.io, and the API version is often reset to v1beta1. Exposure applies only to authors who opt in for new compositions; for operators who do nothing the consequence is no breakage, with a warning that editing live compositions could disrupt or replace resources. Confidence is low because the phrase "minimal changes" is slightly ambiguous and the excerpt is cut off.
